entities.summary:
Proculus of Bologna was a Roman officer martyred at Bologna under Diocletian.

He served as a priest and was executed for his faith in 304 CE, leaving a lasting impact on the early Christian Church.

Proculus' legacy extends to the present day, with his feast day still celebrated in the Catholic Church, and his story has been immortalized in numerous works of art and literature.

His martyrdom marked a pivotal moment in the persecution of Christians during the Diocletian Persecution, and his courage in the face of adversity inspired generations of Christians to follow in his footsteps.

The annals of Christian history are still replete with accounts of Proculus' life and martyrdom, a testament to the enduring power of his faith and the enduring impact of his legacy.
